approved_by: Owner ruling11, 2026-11-07; common numerical definition for all backends

point.frame: stick-local, fixed to the cap and transformed to world each step
point.neutral_definition: Cap top center offset along push direction by0.5*cap radius; intersect the actual cap triangle surface along shell +Z and select the highest surface intersection.
point.cap_identification: Native collision mesh component with highest neutral localZ; derive its XY bounding center and directional half-width radius, report values and selected triangle/barycentric coordinates.

force.frame: controller_body shell frame; transform to world each step
force.native_api: stick_link.add_force_at_point(world_force, world_point, mode='force'); reapply before each step

scoring: Entire hold must tilt>=1deg; low-force entire hold signal<=.05; positive-control final.5s hold signal>=.95; final observation sample<=.05 after unloading. Preserve full trace and raw travel fraction alongside unchanged public signal.
visualization: One image per model/side/force level, actual local cap mesh and measured hold pose/trajectory, force point marker plus horizontal/vertical arrows, no sphere; explicitly label geometry schematic if not native renderer. Write diagrams to a caller-selected output directory.
v1: Preserve existing stick_click_protocol.json ball version; owner supersedes it as fixture-invalid, retain actual execution/setup-error provenance without inventing v1 physics results.
stop_policy: Original task gates remain unless owner explicitly authorizes continuation after another failed prerequisite; no parameter changes or score tuning. New and old results both reported; old low-force misfire is an observation, not a new-model gate.
